environment: Live GitHub Pages in desktop Chromium; 320x667 and 390x844 same-origin iframe display areas, plus 1280px wide iframe and 1348px desktop content viewport. Scrollbars reduce iframe content widths to 305 and 375px.
checks: Rider uses one connected map above LINE-style chat with no map/chat view tabs.
At 390x844 the initial chat composer ends at y=809.23 and the fixed action is hidden, so input is not covered.
Route selected on the map (ふれあいセンター to 駅前ロータリー) and passenger count 1人 entered in chat update the same confirmation.
Inputs survive resizing from 390 to 320px; Core review shows the actual route and one passenger.
320px confirmation has no horizontal overflow; a tall review scrolls inside the dialog and its confirm button is reachable.
Explicit confirmation saves one ride. The rider record and next-role guide are accessible.
Rider-to-driver guide selects receipt 88e058c5 over the existing seed request 6ea71437 and marks it as the current experience.
Driver action without the stopped checkbox is blocked. Each completed operation clears stopped confirmation.
Explicit accept, arrival, boarding and alighting confirmations progress the same receipt through Core.
Another rider tab shows the assigned demo vehicle and then arrival; admin shows one onboard and two waiting (the separate seed request).
Alighting releases seats to 3/3, admin onboard returns to zero, completed total becomes six.
Driver-to-admin guide opens the same completed receipt and its existing record.
Rider reload retains the completed receipt in history and receipt search finds it.
Admin history quick filter displays seven completed/cancelled records without changing operational counts.
All three roles have no horizontal overflow at 320 and 390px; all three stop buttons are inside each map panel.
At 1280px driver and admin retain two-column manual-style boards. Rider stays a 540px column on desktop.
All three public role URLs boot successfully.
limitations: These are desktop browser display-area checks, not physical smartphone, Safari or real on-screen keyboard tests.
Browser-only fictional demo: no cross-device server sync, production identity checks, actual rides, LINE delivery or external payment.
Cancellation, stale-confirmation races, duplicate confirmation and untrusted text were tested in actual-Core JSDOM tests; they were not repeated in this live visual pass.
This is not MLIT conformance verification.
